sentences.text: Sohrai Bedia, aged about 35 years, son of Late Sahdeo Bedia, resident of  Kundrukala Ledero, P.O and P.S. Rajrappa, District Ramgarh  --- --- Petitioner

Versus  The State of Jharkhand --- --- Opp. Party  ---
CORAM: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath ---
For the Petitioner: Mr. Nilesh Kumar, Advocate For the O.P-State: Mr. Praful Jojo, A.P.P.
---
02 / 12.11.2024 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Sadar P.S. Case No. 349 of 2023 arising out of Complaint Case No. 5443 of 2023 for the offences registered under sections 376(2) (n), 313, 417,
323 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of Sri D.N. Shukla, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Ranchi.
3. Petitioner is alleged to have established consensual physical relationship with the prosecutrix who is a major lady.
It is alleged that the petitioner had promised to marry her, but later on, he refused to solemnize marriage.
thereafter, this case has been instituted.
4. It was submitted that the parties were in consensual physical relationship since last two years.
5. Mr. Praful Jojo, learned A.P.P has opposed the prayer for bail, but does not dispute the aforesaid facts.

6. In view of the submissions made above, petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Sri D.N. Shukla, learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Ranchi in Sohrai Bedia vs The State Of Jharkhand --- --- Opp
